# Miele G 7566 Dishwasher

Read local Miele G 7566 dishwasher status through Muse Home Link when its communications module supports the documented local signed/encrypted protocol (MieleH256) and the household's existing GroupID/GroupKey are available in approved secret storage — the skill never provisions them. Status is read first; commands are considered only if the exact model/module protocol documents them and the appliance is safely prepared and panel-armed: remote start is conditional, not promised.
